source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 1 (PDF 4-32), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 1 (Introduction to Software Development) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 8 number ka hai (definition, misalon ke saath wazahat, farq, program likh kar samjhana), aksar definition aur wazahat ke hisson mein (jaise 2 + 3 x 2). Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and state its purpose (2). Explain the requirement gathering, design and development stages (3 x 2). (8 marks)
(SDLC ki definition aur maqsad likhein (2). Requirement gathering, design aur development stages ki wazahat karein (3 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
SDLC: Software Development Life Cycle aik framework hai jo batata hai ke idare application ko shuru ke khayal (conception) se deployment aur maintenance tak kaise banate hain. Maqsad: aisa achha software jo customer ki tawaqqu poori kare, waqt aur kharche ke andaze ke andar mukammal ho aur achhi tarah chale. Stages: requirement gathering, design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance.

1. Requirement gathering: pehle marhale mein users aur stakeholders se baat kar ke maloom kiya jata hai ke software ko kya karna hai (jaise school app ke liye students, teachers, administrators). Activities:
- Interviews aur surveys: users se sawal aur feedback.
- Observations: users ko maujooda system chalate dekhna.
- Document review: maujooda reports aur user manuals dekhna.

2. Design: software ki shakal aur kaam ka mansooba, jaise ghar se pehle blueprint (naqsha). Diagrams (flowchart), models (user interface ke mockups), architecture (majmooi dhancha) aur requirements wazeh ki jati hain.

3. Development: asal software banta hai. Programmers design specifications ko programming language mein code ki soorat mein likhte hain (jaise recipe se cake). Woh code test karte, bugs theek karte aur dobara test karte hain jab tak software agle marhale ke liye tayyar na ho.

book_ref.quote: The primary purpose of SDLC is to deliver high-quality software that meets or exceeds customer expectations

blocks.prompt:
2 What are functional requirements? Write any four functional requirements of a library management system (4). What are non-functional requirements? Explain any four non-functional requirements of the same system (4). (8 marks)
(Functional requirements kya hain? Library management system ki koi chaar functional requirements likhein (4). Non-functional requirements kya hain? Isi system ki chaar non-functional requirements samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Functional requirements system ke khaas kaam batati hain, yani system kya karega (tasks, services, user se rabta). Library system ke liye:
1. User registration: students aur faculty account bana sakein.
2. Book borrowing: kitab dhoond kar le sakein.
3. Book return: kitab wapas kar sakein.
4. Inventory management: librarian kitabein shamil, update aur khatam kar sake.
(Notification: due date aur overdue ki ittila.)

Non-functional requirements system ki quality, performance ke miyar aur pabandiyan batati hain, yani kaam kaise hoga. Isi system ke liye:
1. Performance: 1000 users aik saath bina sust hue.
2. Usability: interface aasaan aur samajh mein aane wala.
3. Reliability: 99.9% waqt dastyab, kam downtime.
4. Security: data encrypt aur mehfooz authentication.
(Scalability: zyada users aur kitabein sambhal sake.)

book_ref.quote: Requirements are generally categorized into two types, functional and nonfunctional requirements

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the testing, deployment and maintenance stages of SDLC. Name the kinds of testing and the steps of deployment. (8 marks)
(SDLC ke testing, deployment aur maintenance stages bayan karein. Testing ki qismein aur deployment ke steps likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Testing (3): software ke bugs, errors ya masail dhoondne ke liye usay jaancha jata hai (quality check). Mukhtalif halaat mein chalaya jata hai:
- Functionality testing: tamam features specifications ke mutabiq.
- Performance testing: zyada traffic ya bhaari data mein theek chalna.
- Compatibility testing: mukhtalif devices aur operating systems par theek chalna.
Testing chhupe masail pakarti hai jo development mein nazar nahi aaye.

2. Deployment (3): software ko users ke liye dastyab karna. Steps:
- Installation: user ke system ya server par install karna.
- Configuration: preferences, network settings, database connections set karna.
- Asal mahol mein testing: doosre systems ke saath theek chalne ki tasdeeq.
Yeh naya store kholne jaisa hai.

3. Maintenance (2): aakhri marhala; musalsal updates se software theek chalta aur nayi zarooraton ya technology ke mutabiq dhalta hai, jaise paude ki dekh bhaal.

book_ref.quote: Testing helps in identifying any hidden issues that were not apparent during development

blocks.prompt:
4 What are software development methodologies and software process models? (2) Explain the importance of process models (3). Compare Scrum, Lean and DevOps by the projects they suit and do not suit (3). (8 marks)
(Software development methodologies aur software process models kya hain? (2) Process models ki ahmiyat samjhayein (3). Scrum, Lean aur DevOps ka muwazna karein ke kin projects ke liye munasib aur ghair munasib hain (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Methodologies software banane ke munazzam tareeqe hain jo planning, tayyari aur intezam ki rehnumai karte hain. Process models software lifecycle ke amal ki abstract tasveer hain jo planning, dhancha aur control ka framework deti hain.

Ahmiyat:
1. Predictability: nataij ka andaza aur risks ka behtar intezam.
2. Efficiency: zaya mehnat kam.
3. Quality: poore lifecycle mein quality assurance.

Scrum, Lean aur DevOps ka muwazna table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: The importance of software process models lies in their ability to provide:

rows: Bar bar updates aur badalti requirements: mobile apps, web development
Pakki requirements: embedded systems, safety-critical software (medical, aerospace)
Tez delivery aur bar bar iterations: startup software, mobile apps, web services
Pechida ya qawaneen wale projects: enterprise systems, embedded systems, aviation control
Web, mobile apps, cloud services jahan tezi aur scaling zaroori (jaise Amazon)
Qawaneen wale ya hardware par munhasir projects (jaise medical devices)

blocks.prompt:
5 Describe the Waterfall Model and its phases (4). Write its benefits and limitations (4). (8 marks)
(Waterfall Model aur is ke phases bayan karein (4). Is ke faide aur khamiyan likhein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Waterfall Model: aisa tareeqa jis mein har phase mukammal hone ke baad agla shuru hota hai, jaise aabshar aik darje se agle mein girta hai. Yeh linear aur sequential hai; mukammal phase par wapas nahi jate. Phases:
1. Requirements: software ki zarooratein jama aur likhna.
2. Design: software kaise banega aur kaisa dikhega.
3. Implementation: asal code likhna.
4. Testing: bugs dhoondna aur theek karna.
5. Deployment: users ke liye jaari karna.
6. Maintenance: istemal ke baad updates aur masail ka hal.

Faide:
1. Saada aur aasaan, wazeh phases.
2. Aik waqt mein aik phase, progress ki nigrani aasaan.
3. Pakki requirements wale chhote projects ke liye munasib.

Khamiyan:
1. Inflexibility: wapas ja kar tabdeeli mushkil aur mehngi.
2. Badalti requirements wale pechida projects ke liye munasib nahi.
3. Farz karta hai ke sab requirements shuru se maloom hain; baad mein nayi zaroorat aaye to risk.

book_ref.quote: Think of it like a waterfall flowing from one stage to the next

blocks.prompt:
6 Define Agile Methodology (2). Explain three Agile practices (3). Write the benefits and limitations of Agile (3). (8 marks)
(Agile Methodology ki definition likhein (2). Agile ki teen practices samjhayein (3). Agile ke faide aur khamiyan likhein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Agile Methodology software banane ka lachakdar (flexible) aur dhalne wala tareeqa hai. Waterfall ke sakht tarteeb ke bar aks Agile software ke chhote chalte hisse jaldi deti hai aur tabdeeli ke mutabiq dhalti hai. Kaam chhote cycles (iterations ya sprints) mein hota hai, is liye hisse jaldi milte aur feedback jaldi aata hai.

Practices:
1. Continuous integration: code ki tabdeeliyan baqaidgi se central repository mein milana taa ke masail jaldi milein.
2. Test-driven development: code se pehle tests likhna.
3. Pair programming: do developers aik workstation par; aik likhta, doosra usi waqt jaanchta.

Faide:
1. High flexibility: development ke dauran bhi requirements badal sakti hain.
2. Customer ki tasalli: baqaidgi se chalta software aur feedback.

Khamiyan:
1. Bare projects mein bohat si teams ka intezam mushkil.
2. Tamam stakeholders ki faal shirkat zaroori.
3. Kam andaza-pazeer: waqt aur scope ka theek andaza mushkil.

book_ref.quote: Agile Methodology is a flexible and adaptive approach to software development

blocks.prompt:
7 Define Lean Software Development (2). Explain its seven key principles (4). Give one kind of project suitable and one not suitable for Lean (2). (8 marks)
(Lean Software Development ki definition likhein (2). Is ke saat ahem usool samjhayein (4). Lean ke liye munasib aur ghair munasib project ki aik aik qisam batayein (2).)
blocks.explanation:
Lean Software Development aik iterative tareeqa hai jo efficiency, zaya khatam karne aur jaldi achha product dene par zor deta hai. Yeh Lean manufacturing ke usoolon se liya gaya hai aur kaam ka bahao behtar kar ke customer ko value deta hai.

Usool:
1. Eliminate waste: be-faida kaam hatao.
2. Amplify learning: musalsal behtari aur seekhna.
3. Decide as late as possible: taaza tareen maloomat par faisla.
4. Deliver as fast as possible: chhote incremental features jaldi do.
5. Empower the team: team ko ikhtiyar aur zimmedari.
6. Build integrity in: shuru se aakhir tak quality.
7. See the whole: poore system aur mahol ko dekhna.

Munasib: tezi aur bar bar iterations wale projects, jaise startup software, mobile apps, web services.
Ghair munasib: bohat pechida ya qawaneen wale projects, jaise enterprise systems, embedded systems, safety-critical apps (aviation control system).

book_ref.quote: Lean Software Development focuses on delivering value to the customer by optimizing the flow of work

blocks.prompt:
8 Define DevOps and state its primary goal (2). Explain four reasons why DevOps should be practised (4). Where is DevOps suitable and where is it less suitable? (2) (8 marks)
(DevOps ki definition aur bunyadi maqsad likhein (2). DevOps apnane ki chaar wajoohat samjhayein (4). DevOps kahan munasib aur kahan kam munasib hai? (2))
blocks.explanation:
DevOps practices ka majmooa hai jo software development (Dev) aur IT operations (Ops) ko jor kar mil jul kar kaam, efficiency aur tezi barhata hai. Maqsad: lifecycle chhota karna, quality behtar karna aur qabil-e-aitmaad musalsal delivery.

Wajoohat:
1. Behtar taawun: development aur operations teams ke darmiyan deewarein khatam.
2. Tez time-to-market: automation aur CI/CD se updates jaldi.
3. Behtar quality: musalsal testing aur nigrani se masail jaldi pakre jate hain.
4. Zyada efficiency: automation se haath ki mehnat aur insani ghalti kam.

Munasib: web, mobile apps aur cloud services, jaise Amazon ka e-commerce platform.
Kam munasib: qawaneen wale ya hardware par munhasir projects, jaise medical devices ka software.

book_ref.quote: DevOps should be practiced because it brings numerous benefits to the software development and delivery process

blocks.prompt:
9 Explain the following parts of project planning and management: comprehensive project planning, setting project timelines, risk assessment and management, and quality assurance (4 x 2). (8 marks)
(Project planning aur management ke yeh hisse samjhayein: comprehensive project planning, project timelines, risk assessment aur management, aur quality assurance (4 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
Software project ki planning safar ki planning jaisi hai: kahan jana hai, kitna waqt aur kitna kharcha.

1. Comprehensive project planning: shuru se pehle tamam tafseelat sochna: kya karna hai, kaun karega, kaise karega.

2. Project timelines: har hisse ka waqt tay karna taa ke project waqt par mukammal ho. Misal: website ke design, content aur testing ke alag waqt.

3. Risk assessment aur management: risks pehchanna (technical, operational, external), un ka imkaan aur asar dekhna, mitigation strategy banana (schedule mein gunjaish, backup resources, mazeed testing) aur musalsal nigrani. Misal: nayi technology ke liye pehle chhota pilot project.

4. Quality assurance: project tay shuda miyar par poora utre aur theek chale; testing, code review, stakeholders ka feedback aur progress ki jaanch. Misal: code durust likha ho aur theek chale.

book_ref.quote: Planning a software project is like planning a trip

blocks.prompt:
10 Name any four key factors in estimating the cost of a software project (2). A company plans a web application for 16 weeks with 1 project manager (PKR 4,000/hour, 20 hours/week), 2 developers (PKR 3,000/hour each, 30 hours/week) and 1 QA tester (PKR 2,000/hour, 20 hours/week). Operational costs are PKR 500,000 and a contingency fund of 10% of the total is added. Calculate the total estimated cost (6). (8 marks)
(Software project ki laagat ke andaze ke koi chaar ahem factors likhein (2). Aik company 16 hafte ke liye web application banati hai: 1 project manager (PKR 4,000 fi ghanta, 20 ghante haftawar), 2 developers (har aik PKR 3,000 fi ghanta, 30 ghante haftawar) aur 1 QA tester (PKR 2,000 fi ghanta, 20 ghante haftawar). Operational costs PKR 500,000 hain aur kul ka 10% contingency fund shamil hai. Kul andazan laagat maloom karein (6).)
blocks.explanation: Factors: development team (tadaad, mahaarat, ghante ka rate), technology stack, project ki muddat, risk management (contingency fund) aur quality assurance. Tareeqa: har kirdar ki laagat = tadaad x rate x ghante haftawar x hafte; operational costs jorein; phir is jor ka 10% contingency jorein.

book_ref.quote: Accurate cost estimation helps in budgeting, resource allocation, and setting realistic expectations

steps: Project manager: 1 x PKR 4,000 x 20 x 16 = PKR 1,280,000
Developers: 2 x PKR 3,000 x 30 x 16 = PKR 2,880,000
QA tester: 1 x PKR 2,000 x 20 x 16 = PKR 640,000

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Contingency fund hamesha baqi tamam items ke asal jor ka 10% hota hai. Kitab ki misal mein yahi ghalti hui thi: jor PKR 18,040,000 tha, is liye fund 1,804,000 aur kul 19,844,000 banta hai.

blocks.prompt:
11 Define UML and state its importance (2). What is a use case? Explain the four steps of identifying use cases (3). Identify the actors and use cases of the online shopping platform described in the chapter (3). (8 marks)
(UML ki definition aur ahmiyat likhein (2). Use case kya hai? Use cases pehchanne ke chaar steps samjhayein (3). Chapter ke online shopping platform ke actors aur use cases batayein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
UML: Unified Modeling Language software design dekhne ka standard tareeqa hai. Yeh pechida systems ko samajhna aur sambhalna aasaan banata hai.

Use case: user (actor) aur system ke darmiyan kisi khaas maqsad ke liye rabton ki tafseel; har use case user ki nazar se mukammal kaam hai.
Steps:
1. Actors pehchanein: insan users ya doosre systems.
2. Har actor ka maqsad tay karein.
3. Actors aur system ke rabte likhein; har ahem nateeje wala rabta mumkina use case hai.
4. Stakeholders ke saath tasdeeq karein.

Online shopping platform:
Actors: Customer, Administrator, Delivery Personnel.
Use cases: Browse Products, Add Items to Cart, Make Purchase (Customer); Manage Product Listings, Process Orders, Handle Customer Inquiries (Administrator); Update Delivery Status (Delivery Personnel).

book_ref.quote: Each use case represents a complete workflow from the user's perspective

blocks.prompt:
12 Explain the class diagram with the book's 'organizing your room' example (4). Explain the sequence diagram of the user organizing items into the boxes (4). (8 marks)
(Kitab ki 'kamra tarteeb dena' wali misal se class diagram samjhayein (4). User ke boxes mein cheezein rakhne ki sequence diagram samjhayein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Class diagram: aik naqsha jo system ki cheezon ki tarteeb aur aapas ka taalluq dikhata hai. Kamre ki misal:
1. Room: poora kamra, class diagram ka bunyadi dhancha.
2. Box: kamre mein dabba, yani class.
3. Attributes: box ki cheezein (ToyBox mein khilone, BookBox mein kitabein).
4. Methods: box ke kaam, jaise open aur close.
5. Khaas boxes: ToyBox, BookBox, ClothesBox aam Box class ki khaas qismein hain; UML mein yeh inheritance khaali tikon wale teer se Box ki taraf dikhai jati hai.

Sequence diagram: objects aik khaas tarteeb mein kaise rabta karte hain, yani waqt ke saath messages ka bahao. Kamre ki misal mein User har box ke saath:
1. open(): box kholta hai.
2. put toys/books/clothes inside: cheezein box mein daalta hai (teer User se box ki taraf).
3. close(): box band karta hai.
Upar se neeche messages parhne se kaam ki tarteeb maloom hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: It helps us see what's in each box (like your toys, books, or clothes) and how these boxes are related

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Sequence diagram mein teer us taraf jata hai jis ko message bheja ja raha hai. User box mein cheez daalta hai, is liye teer User se box ki taraf hai (kitab ki tasveer mein ulta chhapa tha).

blocks.prompt:
13 What is an activity diagram? Explain it with the restaurant management system example (4). Describe three practical applications of UML in software development (4). (8 marks)
(Activity diagram kya hai? Restaurant management system ki misal se samjhayein (4). Software development mein UML ke teen amli istemal bayan karein (4).)
blocks.explanation:
Activity diagram: kisi amal ke qadmon (activities) ka bahao dikhati hai aur pechida kaam ki mantiq samjhati hai. Restaurant system mein:
Start -> Order Placement -> Food Preparation -> Order Delivery -> End
Amal Start se shuru ho kar Order Placement, phir Food Preparation aur aakhir mein Order Delivery tak jata hai; End par khatam. Teer qadmon ki tarteeb dikhate hain.

UML ke amli istemal:
1. Planning: code se pehle requirements aur design ka naqsha.
2. Development: developers system ka dhancha aur taalluqat samajhte hain.
3. Communication: team aur ghair-technical stakeholders system samajhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Above activity diagram shows how a process flows from start to finish

blocks.prompt:
14 Define design patterns (2). Explain the Singleton, Factory, Observer and Strategy patterns with the book's examples (4). Write three applications of design patterns in software design (2). (8 marks)
(Design patterns ki definition likhein (2). Singleton, Factory, Observer aur Strategy patterns kitab ki misalon se samjhayein (4). Software design mein design patterns ke teen istemal likhein (2).)
blocks.explanation:
Design patterns software ke aam masail ke azmaaye hue hal hain; yeh blueprint ya template hain jinhein zaroorat ke mutabiq dhala ja sakta hai.

1. Singleton: object sirf aik dafa banta hai aur har jagah wahi; jaise khaas kamre ki aik chaabi jo sab istemal karte hain.
2. Factory: aik workshop jo mukhtalif cheezein banati hai; zaroorat batayein aur tayyar cheez lein, banane ki fikr nahi.
3. Observer: dilchaspi rakhne wale aik source se updates lete hain; kuch ahem ho to source khud sab ko batata hai.
4. Strategy: aozaar ka toolbox; masle ke kai hal, kaam ke mutabiq chunein aur aasani se badlein.

Istemal:
1. Wazeh dhancha de kar code ki pechidgi kam.
2. Azmaaye hue hal se reusability.
3. Mushtarka vocabulary se developers ka behtar rabta.

book_ref.quote: Design patterns are a fundamental concept in software development

blocks.prompt:
15 Define debugging and bugs (2). Explain three tools and best practices for debugging (3). Differentiate between debugging and testing (3). (8 marks)
(Debugging aur bugs ki definition likhein (2). Debugging ke teen tools aur behtareen tareeqe samjhayein (3). Debugging aur testing mein farq likhein (3).)
blocks.explanation:
Debugging software ke bugs dhoondna aur theek karna hai. Bugs software ki woh ghaltiyan hain jin se woh ghair mutawaqqa rawayya dikhata hai. Software ka rawayya dekh kar masle ki jarr dhoondi jati hai aur code badal kar theek kiya jata hai.

Tools aur tareeqe:
1. Debuggers: code qadam ba qadam chalana, variables dekhna, execution par nazar (jaise GDB, Visual Studio Debugger).
2. Print statements: program ke mukhtalif maqamat par variables ki values dikhana.
3. Code reviews: doosre developers aap ka code jaanchte hain.

Debugging aur testing ka farq table mein hai.

book_ref.quote: Debugging is the process of finding and fixing bugs or errors in a software

rows: Jaanchna ke software requirements poori kare aur theek chale
Code badal kar bug hal hota hai
Chhote hisson se poore system aur user acceptance tak darja ba darja

blocks.prompt:
16 Define testing (2). Explain the four levels of the testing hierarchy: unit, integration, system and acceptance testing (4 x 1.5). (8 marks)
(Testing ki definition likhein (2). Testing ke chaar darje samjhayein: unit, integration, system aur acceptance testing (4 x 1.5).)
blocks.explanation:
Testing software ko jaanchne ka amal hai ke woh requirements poori kare aur theek chale. Yeh chhote hisson se shuru ho kar poore system aur user acceptance tak jati hai.

1. Unit testing: pehla darja; har component ya module alag test hota hai (jaise function ya method). Maqsad: har hissa design ke mutabiq theek chale.
2. Integration testing: unit testing ke baad; mile hue modules ka rabta, interface errors aur data ka bahao check hota hai.
3. System testing: poora software production jaise mahol mein test hota hai; functionality, performance, security aur requirements ki jaanch.
4. Acceptance testing: aakhri darja; tay hota hai ke software release ke liye tayyar hai. Aksar end-users ya clients karte hain (UAT); asal istemal jaise scenarios se usability, reliability aur performance ki tasdeeq.

book_ref.quote: The main types of testing in this hierarchy are given below

blocks.prompt:
17 Explain the following with examples: a framework in software development, an Integrated Development Environment (IDE), online and offline computing platforms, and source code repositories (4 x 2). (8 marks)
(Misalon ke saath samjhayein: software development mein framework, Integrated Development Environment (IDE), online aur offline computing platforms, aur source code repositories (4 x 2).)
blocks.explanation:
1. Framework: concepts, practices aur tools ka standard aur reusable majmooa jo application ki buniyad aur pehle se bane hisse deta hai; developer sirf apna khaas code likhta hai. Misal: Django (user login, database management, page templates tayyar).

2. IDE: aisa software suite jis mein development ke tamam tools aik jagah hain: editor, compiler, debugger aur version control. Misalein: Eclipse (Java), Visual Studio (.NET, C++), PyCharm (Python).

3. Online aur offline platforms: code likhne, chalane aur test karne ka mahol. Online cloud par internet se (Repl.it, Gitpod); offline apne computer par (install shuda IDEs).

4. Source code repositories: code mehfooz karne, sambhalne aur tabdeeliyon ka record rakhne ke platforms; version control se kai developers bina takraao aik project par kaam karte hain. Misalein: GitHub, Bitbucket.

book_ref.quote: IDEs are comprehensive software suites that provide all the tools needed for software development in one place
